title: 8 Mobile Device Management (MDM) Solutions: Our Top Picks by Use Case (2026)
content_md: Microsoft Intune scores highest for the same reason it usually does it ships with Microsoft 365 E3 and E5, so most organizations already own it. Jamf leads on Apple depth, Esper on dedicated and purpose-built Android devices, and Addigy on Apple management for MSPs. Here are eight platforms scored and matched to the buyer each genuinely serves. Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms centralize mobile fleet administration across enterprise networks Best MDM by Use Case — At a Glance Your situation Our pick Score Microsoft 365 E3 or E5 estate Microsoft Intune 8.8 Apple estate, maximum depth Jamf 8.6 Large cross-platform enterprise Omnissa (Workspace ONE) 8.3 Dedicated Android devices at scale Esper 8.0 Android fleets, kiosks, mid-market Scalefusion 7.9 MSP managing many Apple estates Addigy 7.8 Rugged and purpose-built hardware 42Gears 7.6 Regulated, compliance reporting IBM MaaS360 7.4 Definitional answer: Mobile Device Management (MDM) enrols, configures, secures, and monitors mobile devices from a central console enforcing passcode and encryption policy, deploying applications, applying network settings, and enabling remote lock or selective wipe.
